items.summary: Unbounce API integration with managed OAuth. Build and manage landing pages, track leads, and analyze conversion data. Use this skill when users want to interact with Unbounce for landing page management and lead tracking. For other third party apps, use the api-gateway skill (https://clawhub.ai/byungkyu/api-gateway). Calls run through the `maton` CLI with OAuth login, or over raw HTTP with a Maton API key where the CLI cannot be installed. Every call is authenticated as the user's connection and reaches only what that connection's authorization allows, which the provider enforces on every request; the endpoints documented here are the ones this skill uses, and any other endpoint of this app needs the user to ask for it by name. Default to read and list calls, and confirm every write or new connection with the user. This file also documents the three constructs that turn an Unbounce connection into automation, in the order they are used: the connection (the first step), a hosted function that runs an Unbounce action through the Maton SDK, and a trigger that calls that function on a schedule or on an event. Those sections are the platform's own reference text, shared with the api-gateway skill, with Unbounce examples; they add no Unbounce capability - Unbounce is not an event source, a trigger cannot read Unbounce data, and the files under `references/<source>/triggers.md` are the platform's event catalogues for the sources Maton offers (time, Calendly, GitHub, Gmail, HubSpot, Linear, Notion, Slack, Stripe).
